context.orchestrator_notes: RELEASE-VALIDATOR BLOCKED the release on a bench/migrate failure: migration 062 dropped tenant_id from artifact_activations but view v_active_configs (from migration 052) depended on it. BACKEND-DEV fixed 062 (commit 79112125): dependent views dropped before DROP COLUMN (fail-loud if any view other than v_active_configs is found) and v_active_configs recreated after with its original definition minus the removed tenant_id projection. Bench now passes (NFR_RESULT overall_passed=true). RELEASE-VALIDATOR recommended a view-dependency regression test (suggested TC-SPT-02-07) so this class of defect is covered. Add it to the SPT-02 suite.

task.description: Add a view-dependency regression test to the SPT-02 suite (tests/integration/spt02_03_04_schema_tenant_migration_test.zig) covering the defect RELEASE-VALIDATOR caught: migration 062 must be able to drop Class-B tenant_id columns even when a public view (v_active_configs from migration 052) depends on them — the view is dropped before DROP COLUMN and recreated after (minus the removed tenant_id projection). Suggested TC-SPT-02-07: provision a fresh tenant schema / fresh DB path, apply 052 then 061/062/063, and assert (1) migration applies cleanly (no 'cannot drop column ... because other objects depend on it'), (2) public.v_active_configs exists after with its post-062 definition, (3) tenant_default.v_active_configs keeps tenant_id. Update tests/specs/SPT-02.md traceability accordingly. Do NOT change production code — migration 062 is already fixed. Verify the new test passes (zig build test-integration-spt, all 17 now).
acceptance_criteria: View-dependency regression test added to the SPT-02 suite (TC-SPT-02-07 or equivalent)
